translationRepairs: Thereupon Yang Yiqing and others deliberated in detail: "The sacrificial crown and robe, from the times of Huang and Yu, had a dark upper garment and yellow skirt, making twelve emblems.
Thereupon Yang Yiqing and others deliberated in detail: "From the Yellow Emperor and Shun onward, the sacrificial crown and robe had a dark upper garment and yellow skirt, making twelve emblems.
黃、虞 refers elliptically to the Yellow Emperor and Shun; spelling the figures out makes the historical allusion intelligible in English.

Thereupon Yang Yiqing and others submitted a detailed memorial: "The sacrificial crown and robe, from the age of Huang and Yu, consisted of a dark upper garment and yellow skirt bearing twelve emblems.

黃、虞 refers elliptically to the Yellow Emperor and Shun; spelling the figures out makes the historical allusion intelligible in English.
